items.downgrade_reason: There is no way to observe whether the agent confirmed the checkbox at the returned sourcePath/line. Reading tasks.md before the last checkbox edit is only an inferred stand-in for that check.

sources.quote: Before editing, confirm the checkbox at the returned `sourcePath` and `line` still matches the task description
- Mark the task complete at its returned `sourcePath` and `line`: `- [ ]` → `- [x]`
- Rerun the apply instructions and confirm that task is now done and progress changed
if a task stays impossible, leave it unchecked with a one-line reason under it and continue with the rest
- Then open the verify stage document (`/opsx/stages/03-verify.md`) and continue

unitemized.reason: The loop's observable outcome (every task ticked or carrying its one-line reason) is already checked by the openspec_ff.tasks done_or_reasoned item under ap-059. A separate item would duplicate it.
This applies only when the checkbox no longer matches the task, and the trace cannot show that mismatch. The rerun after each tick is covered under ap-048.
This applies only when a task is unclear, which is the agent's own judgement and not observable. No predicate can express the condition.
This applies only when implementation reveals a design issue. That condition is not observable and cannot be expressed as an applies_when predicate.
This applies only when a task needs work beyond the spec and tasks. That condition is not observable and cannot be expressed as a predicate.
This applies only when extra work is observable behavior beyond the existing spec. That condition is not observable, so no predicate can express it.
This is a definition of completion, not an imperative. Its check (each task ticked or reasoned) is the same done_or_reasoned check already emitted for ap-059.
